## Description

Applies Graph Diffusion Convolutional Networks over multi-tier stock dependency graphs to propagate fundamental and technical alpha scores across connected equity universes.

## Where it may fit

Broad cross-sectional equity universes (S&P 500 / Russell 3000), sector contagion and alpha propagation.

## Vehicles

Quantitative Equity Hedge Funds, Systematic Long/Short Factor Funds.

## Required data

Fundamental factor panels, price time series, supply-chain relational adjacency matrices.

## Caveats

Graph diffusion step size hyperparameter requires cross-validation to prevent over-smoothing alpha scores.
